'''Novaldex''' was a company which manufactured a wide range of space technology products. Though their products included such diverse items as heavy-duty [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors and entire [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as the [[Space Warper]], they were best known for producing [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] generators. Of the few [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] classes that had shields, most used Novaldex units.

Novaldex shield generators were used on the following vessels:
*[[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wing]]
*[[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]]
*[[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttle]]
*[[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|''Gamma''-class assault shuttle]]
*[[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]]
*[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]
*[[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]]
*[[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]]
*[[TIE Oppressor]]
